Slay the Day Foil Edition Secret Lair Drop is an exclusive part of Festival in a Box: Las Vegas 2025. These fan-favorite Commanders will be the best dressed at the table, thanks to the inspiring work and fashion instincts of artist Craig Drake.
All cards are English only.
Contents:
•1x Foil Marwyn, the Nurturer
•1x Foil Liesa, Shroud of Dusk
•1x Foil Oloro, Ageless Ascetic
•1x Foil Sythis, Harvest's Hand

When purchasing this unique product, please keep in mind that this Secret Lair Drop Series Sealed Product will ship out to you after the seller receives the product directly from Wizards of the Coast.

The estimated time frame for sellers to receive stock is not fixed, so it could be anywhere between 1 - 10 weeks for delivery.
